One aspect I truly love is the boot space. For a hatchback, it is surprisingly large and extremely practical. Whether it’s grocery runs, weekend luggage, or family trips, the boot easily handles it without feeling cramped. This practicality makes the Wagon R ideal for daily use as well as travel.

Mileage has been excellent even with almost daily driving. I frequently drive through the Western Ghats, and the car feels comfortable on curves and inclines. I have also completed a 700 km drive in a single day, and the upright seating position kept fatigue to a minimum.
